_doc: Per-page 'where to buy' cards rendered by scripts/build-inline-modules.mjs directly under each article's short answer. An item with an `asin` must be a resolved ASIN in data/amazon-asins.csv (the exact-product list Cowork verified) or the build refuses. An item with `href` is a merchant deep link already vetted on that page. No prices are rendered unless data/amazon-prices.json holds a price for that ASIN checked within the last 36 hours — never a remembered one.

items.label: Wilson Profile SGI Complete Set
items.for: Two wedges in the box, and it comes in standard, tall and senior lengths.
items.note: Men's listing. The women's set is below.

items.label: Wilson Profile SGI Women's Complete Set
items.for: Petite, standard and tall lengths with lighter shafts. Nothing in the Strata range fits this way.
items.note: Check stand vs cart bag on the listing.

items.label: Callaway Strata 12-Piece
items.for: The cheapest way into the recognisable brand. No sand wedge in this version.
items.note: Men's right-hand 12-piece listing.

items.label: Callaway Strata 14-Piece
items.for: The Strata most people should buy: adds the sand wedge and a graphite 3-wood.
items.note: Men's right-hand 14-piece listing.

items.label: Winn Dri-Tac Oversize
items.for: Start here: soft, tacky and oversize, so you can hold the club with the least squeezing.
items.note: Sold as a single grip. A full set is 13.

items.label: JumboMax
items.for: The step up to a true jumbo if your arthritis is severe or your grip strength has dropped.
items.note: Sold singly. The listing carries several sizes; the article's tape build-up test tells you which.

items.label: Winn Dri-Tac
items.for: Maximum cushion, sore joints, wet weather, or going oversize without adding swing weight.
items.note: Sold as a single grip. A full set is 13.

items.label: Golf Pride CP2 Wrap
items.for: Longevity and a slightly firmer, more connected feel. Commonly lasts a full season.
items.note: Sold as a single grip. A full set is 13.

posts/best-left-handed-golf-club-sets.ht.heading: Where to buy the picks
posts/best-left-handed-golf-club-sets.ht.lead: These two listings are the left-handed versions. The Wilson men's set and the Cobra also come left-handed, but their left-hand stock comes and goes, so the shortlist below links the listings and you confirm the hand there before you pay.

items.label: Callaway Strata Plus 14-Piece, Left Hand
items.for: The trusted default, with a sand wedge in the box.
items.note: This listing is the left-hand men's 14-piece.

items.label: Wilson Profile Women's Complete Set, Left Hand
items.for: The women's set that actually ships left-handed.
items.note: 11-piece with a cart bag.

posts/best-golf-irons-for-seniors.html.heading: Where to buy the picks
posts/best-golf-irons-for-seniors.html.lead: Two of the picks are sold on Amazon. The XXIO 14 and Ping G440 go through fitters and brand dealers, so they are not linked here. Whichever you choose, get fit for shaft weight and flex first.

items.label: Cleveland Launcher XL Halo
items.for: Best value of the picks: maximum forgiveness and easy launch at the lowest price.
items.note: Check the shaft on the listing; you want the lightweight graphite option.

items.label: Srixon ZXiR / ZXiR HL
items.for: Forgiveness with premium feel. The HL version adds height and carry for slower swings.
items.note: Confirm HL vs standard on the listing.

posts/best-golf-shoes-for-wide-feet.html.heading: Where to buy the picks
posts/best-golf-shoes-for-wide-feet.html.lead: Buy your true length in a wider width, not a longer shoe. Sizing differs by brand, so use a seller with easy returns.

items.label: FootJoy Pro/SL
items.for: Best overall: a proven spikeless shoe you can order in an exact width up to extra wide.
items.note: Pick the width on TGW's size menu.

items.label: New Balance 997 SL
items.for: Best value with named wide and extra-wide options (2E and 4E).
items.note: Confirm the width code on the listing before you order.

items.label: ECCO Biom C5
items.for: Premium all-weather comfort on a naturally roomy last.
items.note: Standard width only; it fits wide because of the shape.

items.label: adidas S2G SL
items.for: A roomier-than-usual standard fit for moderately wide feet.
items.note: No width sizes; if you need a true wide, take the FootJoy or New Balance.

posts/kirkland-ks1-putter-vs-scotty-came.heading: Where to buy
posts/kirkland-ks1-putter-vs-scotty-came.lead: The Kirkland KS1 is sold only through Costco, in the warehouse and on costco.com, and it sells out. There is no steady listing to link. If you cannot catch one, these are the picks that are actually in stock.

items.label: Cleveland HB SOFT Milled
items.for: Best budget milled-feel pick, easy to find in stock, in blade or mallet.
items.note: Choose the head shape on the listing.

items.label: Odyssey Ai-ONE
items.for: Forgiveness, easy alignment and a soft insert from the biggest putter brand.
items.note: Double Wide is the mallet version.

items.label: Wilson Infinite
items.for: Best budget mallet: forgiving and stable without premium pricing.
items.note: Buckingham and Windy City are the two head shapes.

posts/golf-ball-speed-chart.html.heading: Get your own number
posts/golf-ball-speed-chart.html.lead: These are the radars that will give you your own row.

items.label: PRGR HS-130A swing speed radar
items.for: Club speed and ball speed, nothing else. The cheapest way to get the two numbers this page is about.
items.note: No launch or spin. Reads from behind or beside the ball.

items.label: Garmin Approach R10
items.for: Adds launch, spin and carry. Garmin's spec gives ball speed accuracy of 1 mph; MyGolfSimulator's table of the same sheet gives 3 mph on club speed.
items.note: Below 90 mph of ball speed the spin figure is calculated, not measured.

items.label: Rapsodo MLM2PRO
items.for: Camera plus radar, with video of every swing. Spin needs its marked balls.
items.note: Rapsodo publishes no ball-speed tolerance.

items.label: SkyTrak+
items.for: Camera for the ball, Doppler radar for the club. The unit most people end up with when they want a simulator later.

posts/golf-simulator-shed.html.heading: What a shed build costs today
posts/golf-simulator-shed.html.lead: These are the packages the article's dimensions were checked against.

posts/golf-shoe-size-chart.html.heading: Shoes that publish what they are
posts/golf-shoe-size-chart.html.lead: The makers below either sell real widths or publish a centimetre table you can check your foot against.

items.label: SQAIRZ Velo
items.for: The maker with the only published brand-switch rule, and a wide forefoot by design.
items.note: Sizing: keep your FootJoy, Skechers, Puma or New Balance size; go a half down from adidas, Nike or ECCO.

items.label: New Balance 997 SL
items.for: Sold in D and 2E, with a published centimetre table that matches FootJoy's.
items.note: Half sizes stop at 12.

items.label: FootJoy Pro/SL
items.for: Narrow to X Wide (3E). The one maker whose advice is "try a wider width before sizing up", because it can.
items.note: Pick the width on TGW's size menu.

items.label: ECCO Biom C5
items.for: Whole EU sizes only; fits wide by shape rather than by width SKU.
items.note: A 28 cm foot is ECCO's EU 44, sold as 10 / 10.5.

posts/golf-ball-position-chart.html.heading: The only equipment this page needs

items.label: SuperStroke alignment sticks
items.for: One across your toes, one pointing at the ball. Ball position is invisible from above the ball; this is how you see it.
items.note: Two 45-inch fibreglass rods. Any pair will do; these are the ones that fit a bag.
